definitions.explanation: The part of a garment covering the arm.

examples.japanese: {長|なが}{袖|そで}のシャツを{着|き}る。

notes:
{袖|そで} means sleeve.

TYPES:
- {長袖|ながそで}: long sleeves
- {半袖|はんそで}: short sleeves

EXPRESSIONS:
- {袖|そで}を{引|ひ}く: to tug at someone's sleeve
- {袖|そで}の{下|した}: bribe (lit. under the sleeve)
- {袖|そで}にする: to cold-shoulder someone
